```{r}
#| label: setup
library(bigrquery)
library(PristineSeasR2)
library(tidyverse)

ps_paths <- ps_science_paths()

bigrquery::bq_auth(email = "marine.data.science@ngs.org")
bq_connection <- DBI::dbConnect(bigrquery::bigquery(), project = "pristine-seas")
```

# Query BQ

```{r}
relevant_exps <- c("PLW_2024","PNG_2024","SLB_2024",
                   "NIU_2023","RMI_2023",
                   "DMA_2022","COL_2022",
                   "NIU_2016","FRA_2016","SYC_2015","PYF_2014","PLW_2014","MOZ_2014","NCL_2013","PCN_2012")

uvs_sites <- tbl(bq_connection, "uvs.sites") |>
  filter(exp_id %in% relevant_exps) |> 
  select(exp_id, ps_site_id, locality, habitat, exposure, date, time, latitude, longitude, in_mpa) |> 
  collect()

coral_stations <- tbl(bq_connection, "uvs.lpi_stations") |> 
  filter(exp_id %in% relevant_exps) |>
  filter(!region %in% c("Golfo de Tribugá", "Antiope")) |> 
  filter(!habitat %in% c("kelp_forest","seagrass")) |> 
  collect()

coral_stations <- coral_stations |> 
  mutate(region = case_when(exp_id %in% c("PLW_2024", "PCN_2012", "PLW_2014") ~ subregion,
                            TRUE ~ region))

coral_stations |> 
  count(habitat, sort = T)

coral_stations |> 
  count(exposure, sort = T)

coral_stations |> 
  count(depth_strata, sort = T)
```

# Cover by station (depth strata)

```{r}
cover_by_station <- coral_stations |> 
  filter(depth_strata %in% c("shallow", "deep")) |>
  group_by(exp_id, region, ps_site_id, habitat, exposure, depth_strata) |> 
  summarize(# list of divers 
            divers =  paste(sort(unique(divers)), collapse = " | "),
            across(starts_with("pct_"), ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
            .groups = "drop")
```

```{r eval = F}
tmp <- cover_by_station |> 
  filter(region == "Ngederrak") |> 
  group_by(ps_site_id, habitat, exposure) |> 
  summarize(pct_coral = mean(pct_coral, na.rm = TRUE)) |> 
  left_join(uvs_sites |> 
              select(exp_id, ps_site_id, locality, latitude, longitude), 
            by = c("ps_site_id")) |> 
  sf::st_as_sf(coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = 4326) 

mapview::mapview(tmp,
                 zcol = "pct_coral",
                 legend = TRUE,
                 map.types = "Esri.WorldImagery",
                 layer.name = "pct_coral",
                 popup = leafpop::popupTable(tmp, 
                                             zcol = c("ps_site_id", "locality","habitat", "exposure"))) |> 
  leafem::addMouseCoordinates() |> 
  leaflet.extras::addFullscreenControl()
```

```{r}
cover_by_region_and_strata <- cover_by_station |> 
  group_by(exp_id, region, depth_strata) |> 
   summarize(n = n(),
             across(starts_with("pct_"), ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
            .groups = "drop") |> 
  mutate(across(starts_with("pct_"), ~ ifelse(is.nan(.x), NA_real_, round(.x, 3))))
```

```{r}
standardize_benthic_groups <- function(x, palette) {
  
  x_std <- dplyr::case_when(
    
    # --- corals ---
    x == "coral"        ~ "hard_coral",
    x == "soft_coral"   ~ "soft_coral",
    
    # --- algae ---
    x == "algae_erect"  ~ "algae_erect",
    x == "algae_canopy" ~ "algae_canopy",
    x %in% c("algae_encrust", "algae_encrusting") ~ "algae_encrusting",
    x == "cca"          ~ "cca",
    x == "eam"          ~ "turf",
    x == "turf"         ~ "turf",
    
    # --- other benthos ---
    x == "sponges"      ~ "sponges",
    x == "seagrass"     ~ "other",
    x == "other"        ~ "other",
    
    # --- cyanobacteria ---
    x %in% c("cyano", "cyanobacteria") ~ "cyanobacteria",
    
    # --- substrate ---
    x %in% c("rubble", "sediment", "sand", "barren") ~ "sediment | rubble | barren",
    
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
  
  # enforce palette order as factor
  factor(x_std, levels = rev(names(ps_colors("functional_groups"))))
}
```

```{r}
region_order <- cover_by_region_and_strata |>
  filter(depth_strata == "shallow") |>
  mutate(region = paste(exp_id, region, sep = " — ")) |>
  arrange(desc(pct_coral), desc(pct_cca)) |>
  pull(region)


cover_by_region_strata_long <- cover_by_region_and_strata |>
  pivot_longer(cols      = starts_with("pct_"),
               names_to  = "group",
               values_to = "avg_cover") |>
  mutate(region  = paste(exp_id, region, sep = " — "),
         region  = factor(region, levels = region_order),
         group   = str_remove_all(group, "^pct_") |>
           standardize_benthic_groups()) |> 
  filter(!is.na(avg_cover))

benthic_palette <- c(
  hard_coral                   = "#1B3F7A",
  cca                          = "#D63F6B",
  soft_coral                   = "#38B6CC",
  algae_erect                  = "#1E7A45",
  algae_encrusting             = "#6BBF96",
  algae_canopy                 = "#C49A00",
  sponges                      = "#FF6B35",  # ← vivid coral-orange
  other                        = "#5C4A7A",
  cyanobacteria                = "#C6D400",
  turf                         = "#7A5C35",
  `sediment | rubble | barren` = "#C8BEA8"
)


```


```{r}
coral_labels <- cover_by_region_strata_long |>
  filter(group == "hard_coral", depth_strata ) |>
  select(region, depth_strata, avg_cover, n_sites = n)

cover_by_region_strata_long |>
  filter(depth_strata %in% c("shallow")) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = region, y = avg_cover, fill = group)) +
  geom_col(position = "fill", width = 0.85) +
  geom_text(data  = coral_labels,
            aes(y = avg_cover / 100, label = sprintf("%.0f%%", avg_cover), fill = NULL),
            hjust = 1.15, size = 2.6, color = "white", fontface = "bold") +
  geom_text(data  = coral_labels,
            aes(y = 1.01, label = paste0("n=", n_sites), fill = NULL),
            hjust = 0, size = 2.4, color = "grey50") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(scale = 100),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.08))) +
  coord_flip(clip = "off") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = benthic_palette)+
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Benthic cover (%)", fill = NULL,
       title    = "Benthic community composition across Pristine Seas expeditions",
       subtitle = "Ordered by hard coral cover") +
  theme_ps() +
  theme(legend.position    = "bottom",
        legend.title       = element_blank(),
        legend.key.size    = unit(0.4, "cm"),
        legend.text        = element_text(size = 8),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "grey88", linewidth = 0.4),
        axis.text.y        = element_text(size = 8.5),
        axis.title.x       = element_text(size = 10, margin = margin(t = 8)),
        plot.title         = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"),
        plot.subtitle      = element_text(size = 9, color = "grey50", margin = margin(b = 10)),
        plot.margin        = margin(12, 55, 12, 12)) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 1, reverse = T))
```



# Cover by site

```{r}
avg_cover_by_site <- coral_stations |> 
  group_by(exp_id, region, ps_site_id, habitat, exposure) |> 
  summarize(# list of divers 
            divers =  paste(sort(unique(divers)), collapse = " | "),
            across(starts_with("pct_"), ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
            .groups = "drop")

avg_cover_by_region <- avg_cover_by_site |> 
  group_by(exp_id, region) |> 
   summarize(n = n(),
             across(starts_with("pct_"), ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
            .groups = "drop") |> 
  mutate(across(starts_with("pct_"), ~ ifelse(is.nan(.x), NA_real_, round(.x, 3))))

region_order <- avg_cover_by_region |>
  mutate(region = paste(exp_id, region, sep = " — ")) |>
  arrange(desc(pct_coral), desc(pct_cca)) |>
  pull(region)
```



```{r}
avg_cover_by_region_long <- avg_cover_by_region |>
  pivot_longer(cols      = starts_with("pct_"),
               names_to  = "group",
               values_to = "avg_cover") |>
  mutate(region  = paste(exp_id, region, sep = " — "),
         region  = factor(region, levels = region_order),
         group   = str_remove_all(group, "^pct_") |>
           standardize_benthic_groups()) |> 
  filter(!is.na(avg_cover))
```

```{r}
coral_labels <- avg_cover_by_region_long |>
  filter(group == "hard_coral") |>
  select(region, avg_cover, n_sites = n)

benthic_palette <- c(

)

avg_cover_by_region_long |>
  ggplot(aes(x = region, y = avg_cover, fill = group)) +
  geom_col(position = "fill", width = 0.85) +
  geom_text(data  = coral_labels,
            aes(y = avg_cover / 100, label = sprintf("%.0f%%", avg_cover), fill = NULL),
            hjust = 1.15, size = 2.6, color = "white", fontface = "bold") +
  geom_text(data  = coral_labels,
            aes(y = 1.01, label = paste0("n=", n_sites), fill = NULL),
            hjust = 0, size = 2.4, color = "grey50") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(scale = 100),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.08))) +
  coord_flip(clip = "off") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = benthic_palette)+
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Benthic cover (%)", fill = NULL,
       title    = "Benthic community composition across Pristine Seas expeditions",
       subtitle = "Ordered by hard coral cover") +
  theme_ps() +
  theme(legend.position    = "bottom",
        legend.title       = element_blank(),
        legend.key.size    = unit(0.4, "cm"),
        legend.text        = element_text(size = 8),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "grey88", linewidth = 0.4),
        axis.text.y        = element_text(size = 8.5),
        axis.title.x       = element_text(size = 10, margin = margin(t = 8)),
        plot.title         = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"),
        plot.subtitle      = element_text(size = 9, color = "grey50", margin = margin(b = 10)),
```

```{r}
site_coral <- avg_cover_by_site |>
  mutate(region = paste(exp_id, region, sep = " — "),
         region = factor(region, levels = region_order))

site_coral |>
  ggplot(aes(x = region, y = pct_coral)) +
  # Distribution: individual sites as jittered points
  geom_jitter(width = 0.25, height = 0, 
              size = 1.2, alpha = 0.35, color = "#1a3a6b") +
  # IQR bar
  stat_summary(fun.data = \(x) data.frame(
                 ymin = quantile(x, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
                 y    = median(x, na.rm = TRUE),
                 ymax = quantile(x, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)),
               geom = "linerange", linewidth = 1.2, color = "#1a3a6b") +
  # Median dot
  stat_summary(fun = \(x) median(x, na.rm = TRUE),
               geom = "point", shape = 21,
               size = 3, fill = "white", color = "#1a3a6b", stroke = 1.2) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_number(suffix = "%"),
                     limits = c(0, 90),
                     breaks = seq(0, 75, 25)) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Hard coral cover (%)",
       title    = "Hard coral cover distribution across Pristine Seas sites",
       subtitle = "Median (circle), IQR (bar), individual sites (points) · ordered by regional mean") +
  theme_ps() +
  theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "grey88", linewidth = 0.4),
        axis.text.y        = element_text(size = 8.5),
        axis.title.x       = element_text(size = 10, margin = margin(t = 8)),
        plot.title         = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"),
        plot.subtitle      = element_text(size = 9, color = "grey50", margin = margin(b = 10)),
        plot.margin        = margin(12, 20, 12, 12))

ggsave(file.path(ps_paths$projects, "legacy-db/figures/coral_cover_distribution_by_region.pdf"),
       width = 12, height = 12, dpi = 300)
```

# Export

```{r}
avg_cover_by_site |> 
  left_join(uvs_sites, 
            by = c("exp_id", "ps_site_id", "habitat", "exposure")) |> 
  select(exp_id, region, ps_site_id, date, time, longitude, latitude, habitat, exposure, in_mpa, divers, everything()) |> 
  write_csv(file.path(ps_paths$projects, "legacy-db/data/output/uvs/_lpi_cover_by_site_for_GCRMN_IUCN.csv"))
```
